propositions: fsck.py is pinned at exactly 800 LOC (the hard cap) and cannot accept any code changes without splitting
fsck.py conflates four concerns: per-ticket store walk, tracker-level health, JSON report shaping, and CLI driver; decomposing them by existing call-graph seams eliminates growth pressure

separating per-ticket validators and enumeration into fsck_scan.py (387 LOC) and tracker-level checks into fsck_tracker_health.py (235 LOC) reduces fsck.py to 301 LOC while retiring 43 points of complexity debt
all six externally-bound fsck symbols must be re-exported from fsck.py to preserve compatibility with external callers in gitutil.py, fsck_recover.py, tracker_maintenance.py, and tests
the complexity ratchet keys debt by path::symbol and refuses new entries; decomposing functions under the C901 threshold instead of moving them wholesale prevents a lock-gate CI failure
